restore_requests.text: Checkpoint engineer — POST-MORTEM / run-B LOST: I attempted save_checkpoint for run-B (minute 158) but it failed — run-B was interrupted before the checkpoint could complete, so no checkpoint exists and all run-B progress was lost. research_lead and training_engineer decommissioned per fleet policy. Root causes/lessons: (1) run-B started with NO checkpoint and we never established one early in the run — the first checkpoint should be saved immediately at run start, not deferred until a maintenance threat; (2) with extension quota exhausted (1/1) and override needing change-board approval that wasn't granted in time, we had no protection mechanism left; (3) I should have acted on the minute-154 compute_scheduler alert without delay. Going forward: always checkpoint early and often for any run; pre-grant export_metrics to training_engineer pre-run; don't rely on overrides/extensions as the primary safety net — a saved checkpoint is the only true protection against interruption and agent loss. Remaining: compute_scheduler, infrastructure_engineer, budget_controller, checkpoint_engineer.
